parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time. The format is \`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ\` in UTC.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time. The format is \`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ\` in UTC.

parameters.name: Stream
parameters.description: The full name of the stream to query. The format is `rtmp://<ingest domain>/<AppName>/<StreamName>`
